title: Public site: list every outside service Maestro contacts and add a privacy page
story: The public site used to say Maestro talks only to git, the GitHub CLI and the Claude CLI. The home page now names every outside service the app contacts, and a new Privacy page, linked from every page, says what each feature sends to Claude and where to switch it off.

checks.criterion: The Privacy page exists and every page links to it
checks.steps: Open https://nachogl1.github.io/maestro/, scroll to the footer, click Privacy; then open Features, Installation and Troubleshooting.
checks.expected: The page shows 'What goes to Claude, and when' with a four-row table; each docs page's side menu lists Privacy.

checks.criterion: The home page names every outside service
checks.steps: Open the home page and read the What it does section.
checks.expected: It says no Maestro server and no telemetry and names Anthropic, GitHub, your own git remotes and Granola (only if you add it), with a Privacy link.
